name: popnow
description: Create images, videos, music, voiceovers, ads, explainers, 3D models and browser games with your PopNow account through the PopNow MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Images, video, music, ads and games with your PopNow account
interface.longDescription: PopNow turns Codex into a creative studio. Make and edit pictures and videos, write songs and voiceovers, add sound, make 3D models, creator-style ads, brand films and narrated explainers, keep the same character across shots, and build browser games that PopNow puts online at a link anyone can play. Sign in with your PopNow account (OAuth). Larger jobs show their price in PopNow credits first and start only after you say yes.
defaultPrompt: Make a cinematic poster of a lighthouse in a storm, 16:9
Turn this product photo into a 5-second vertical video
Build a tiny browser game where a cat catches falling fish and put it online
